reason: The README describes a dsh plugin whose primary purpose is to bridge a view_image tool to configurable OpenAI-compatible vision-language model endpoints, allowing text-only DeepSeek sessions to analyze local images.

summaries.zh: 该插件通过 view_image 工具将本地图片和用户问题转发至兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉语言模型，以便文本模型获得图像分析能力。
summaries.en: This plugin adds image analysis to text-only DeepSeek sessions by sending local images and user questions through a view_image tool to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision-language model endpoint.

capabilities: Reads local image files provided to the view_image tool
Sends images and user questions to a configured OpenAI-compatible VLM endpoint
Uses configured API keys or environment variables for external service authentication
